title: Wedding Guest Outfit Ideas: Why a Royal Blue Anarkali Is Always the Right Answer
excerpt: Not too bridal, never underdressed: why a flowy royal blue georgette Anarkali is the perfect wedding guest outfit – plus jewellery, shoe and dupatta draping tips.
body:
Choosing a wedding guest outfit is a balancing act: you want to look beautiful in every photo, but you never want to compete with the bride. A flowy Anarkali in a rich jewel tone solves this every time – and royal blue might be the most flattering of them all.

## Why royal blue works at every wedding

- **It suits every skin tone.** Royal blue brightens fair skin and glows on wheatish and deeper skin.
- **It never clashes with the bride.** Brides usually wear red, pink or pastels – blue keeps you elegant and distinct.
- **It photographs beautifully** in both daylight and evening lights.

## Meet the royal blue georgette Anarkali

Our [royal blue georgette Anarkali suit](/products/royal-blue-georgette-anarkali-suit-gota-handwork-dupatta/) has a sweetheart neckline with gold hand embroidery, scattered gold buttis on the bodice and a full, flowing flare finished with gota lace. The georgette dupatta is edged in matching gota lace. Light georgette means it twirls beautifully – and you can dance all night without feeling weighed down.

## How to style it for each function

| Function | Jewellery | Shoes | Hair |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sangeet | Kundan jhumkas | Block heels | Loose curls |
| Wedding ceremony | Statement earrings + maang tikka | Pearl heels | Low bun with flowers |
| Reception | Polki or gold drop earrings | Metallic heels | Sleek side part |

## 3 ways to drape the dupatta

1. **One shoulder:** pin it on the left shoulder and let it fall – easy and graceful.
2. **Both arms:** drape across your back and over both elbows – perfect for photos.
3. **Classic front:** let it fall evenly over both shoulders for a traditional look.

## Prefer something lighter for the day functions?

For haldi, mehendi or a family lunch, try our [baby pink bird embroidered cotton kurta set](/products/baby-pink-bird-embroidered-cotton-kurta-pant-set/) – soft cotton, a folk-inspired embroidered yoke and playful tassels.

## Frequently asked questions

**Is georgette comfortable for long events?**
Yes – georgette is light and flowy, and the Anarkali is lined for comfort.

**How should I store an Anarkali with gota lace?**
Fold it with tissue paper between the layers and keep it in a cotton bag. Dry clean only.
